comment: restore.c restore_menu() preselects 'Never mind (quit)' and quits unless select_menu() returns more than 0. In a tty PICK_ONE menu the preselected row's own selector, and its group accelerator when that matches exactly one row, toggle it off and end the menu with n == 0. A Tourist and a Caveman save; the third and fourth segments' rc names no hero, so tty_askname() shows the selectsaved menu. Segment 3 presses 'q', the quit row's selector; segment 4 presses 'Q', its group accelerator. Both quit. Seeds, clocks, characters and inputs were chosen independently of every recorded session.
